observation.interpretation: Prefill completed and the decode-16 begin marker was printed; no decode-16 comparison or return marker appeared before timeout. This is an incomplete timeout, not evidence of an unsupported instruction or numerical failure.

comparison.conclusion: A single startup ame_fence() is not a validated fix and is associated with a repeatable decode-16 timeout in this comparison. Keep the default ame_startup=none pending a separate hardware explanation.

limits: The worker completed its configured timeout without a trap context; the exact hardware PC is unknown.
The prime image changes code layout and AME state, so this result does not prove that ame_fence itself is the root cause.
No default runtime or model source was changed by this experiment.
